description: Source code for a Broadcom Wireless Driver Control Utility, including command handling, ioctl wrappers, and command definitions.

methods.name: wlc_ioctl
methods.description: Wrapper for wireless ioctl commands based on parameters.

methods.name: wlc_iovar
methods.description: Wrapper for iovar commands for setting/getting driver variables.

methods.name: wlc_bssiovar
methods.description: Wrapper for BSS-specific driver variables.

methods.name: wlc_vif_enabled
methods.description: Enable or disable a virtual interface.

methods.name: wlc_ssid
methods.description: Get or set the SSID of the interface.

methods.name: wlc_int
methods.description: Get or set integer driver parameters.

methods.name: wlc_flag
methods.description: Set a flag parameter.

methods.name: wlc_string
methods.description: Get string driver parameters.

methods.name: wlc_afterburner
methods.description: Enable or disable Broadcom Afterburner feature.

methods.name: wlc_maclist
methods.description: Get or set MAC address list for filters.

methods.name: wlc_radio
methods.description: Get or set radio state.

methods.name: wlc_wsec_key
methods.description: Set or remove WEP keys.

methods.name: wlc_cap
methods.description: Get capabilities.

methods.name: wlc_bssmax
methods.description: Get maximum number of BSSs supported.

methods.name: cw2ecw
methods.description: Convert contention window to ECW value.

methods.name: wlc_wme_ac
methods.description: Configure WME access categories.

methods.name: wlc_ifname
methods.description: Get or set interface name.

methods.name: wlc_wdsmac
methods.description: Get WDS remote MAC address.

methods.name: wlc_pmk
methods.description: Set WPA passphrase.

methods.name: find_cmd
methods.description: Find command by name in command list.

methods.name: do_command
methods.description: Execute a command with optional argument.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Display usage information.
